*Graduate Student in Applied Statistics · Illinois State University*

## About Me

Welcome to my academic website.

I am **Samuel Bonney**, a graduate student in Applied Statistics at [Illinois State University](https://illinoisstate.edu/).

I earned my Bachelor of Arts in Mathematics and Statistics from the [University of Ghana](https://www.ug.edu.gh/) and am currently pursuing my master's degree in Applied Statistics at Illinois State University.

My current research focuses on **nonparametric statistical methodology**, including tilted kernel density estimation and Bickel–Rosenblatt goodness-of-fit testing. I am also interested in spatial statistics, statistical learning, machine learning, and public-health applications.

My broader work includes county-level spatial analyses of lung cancer mortality and chronic disease burden, explainable machine learning for malaria risk, and large language model applications in clinical text classification.

I enjoy combining statistical theory, computation, simulation, and visualization to address practical problems and communicate results clearly.
